record.question: The Department of Tourism, Mizoram was established on:
record.explanation: The printed page confirms the four dates and contains no special qualification. Mizoram’s Tourism Department was established on April 24, 1987 by bifurcation of the Information, Public Relations and Tourism Department, as reported by EastMojo on July 28, 2025 (https://eastmojo.com/mizoram/2025/07/28/mizoram-wins-emerging-eco-nature-retreat-award-at-national-tourism-conclave/); confidence is medium because the exact establishment date is supported here by a news report rather than the original notification.
